notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2021-05-10; date placeholders '[ ], 2021' remain) for the reorganizations of PCI and PKO into PDI. Exchange is NAV for NAV (cash in lieu of fractional Merger Shares). PCI shareholders do not vote; PDI shareholders vote on the share issuance and PKO shareholders on the Plan of Reorganization; the PKO merger is contingent on the PCI merger, the PCI merger is not contingent on PKO ('other' condition). termination_date is printed in brackets in the form of agreement ('[August 12, 2021]'), a draft placeholder that falls before the stated expected close of two to three months after the July 28, 2021 meeting. record_date appears as '[June 10, 2021]' in one place and unbracketed 'June 10, 2021' in the voting section. Tickers PDI, PCI, PKO are the NYSE symbols stated in the text. Conditions are from the form of Agreement and Plan of Reorganization (Appendix A); 'regulatory_approval' is the condition that the Acquiring Fund receive any necessary SEC and state securities orders. The plan also requires a distribution of all income before the exchange (not mapped).
